verdict.rationale: Mercury documents several built-in background automations: automatic invoices, receipts auto-attached to card transactions, AI-powered bookkeeping automations, and auto-funding rules for accounts, which a long-time customer corroborates. These are fixed-purpose features, not a general way to set up custom autonomous automations. The API, CLI, webhooks and MCP are building blocks for external scripts or agents, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation or rules builder, documented recurring schedules or triggers you define yourself, autonomous agent-driven background execution inside Mercury, and in-depth docs on how automatic invoices and auto-funding rules are configured.
